step2.ptxt: With the audio OFF and ACC ON (IG switch ACC), while pressing preset buttons "1" and "6" simultaneously, press the "DISC" switch 3 times.

atten4.ptxt: The buzzer sounds 3 times, diagnosis starts, and the system enters all element lighting mode.
In all element lighting mode, element display inspection and panel switch operation inspection are possible.

step2.ptxt: Check that there is no abnormality in element lighting.
Check that the buzzer sounds when each panel switch is pressed.

atten4.ptxt: Pressing the "SEEK/TRACK UP" switch moves to the service inspection screen, so check its operation by the screen change.

step2.ptxt: Press the "SEEK/TRACK UP" switch in all element lighting mode.

item.ptxt: The system enters service inspection mode.
It may take approximately 40 seconds for the inspection to complete.

When service inspection mode is entered, the system inspection and diagnostic memory inspection are performed, and the inspection results are displayed in ascending order of device code (physical address).

step2.ptxt: Press and hold the "DISC" switch for 2 seconds or more. Or, turn the IG OFF.

entry.ptxt: When no DTC is detected in either "System Check Confirmation" or "Diagnostic Memory Response"
When the system recognized the device at registration, but the device does not respond to the "Diagnosis ON Instruction" command
Inspect the power supply system and AVC-LAN communication wire harness of the device indicated by the device code (physical address)

When "Diagnosis ON Confirmation" confirms that the device supports current diagnosis, and there are 1 or more DTCs subject to "Replace" in either "System Check Result Response" or "Diagnostic Memory Response"
Move to detailed inspection information display mode and inspect the malfunctioning area from the DTC chart

When "Diagnosis ON Confirmation" confirms that the device supports current diagnosis, and there are no DTCs subject to "Replace" but 1 or more DTCs subject to "Inspect" in either "System Check Result Response" or "Diagnostic Memory Response"
Move to detailed inspection information display mode and inspect the malfunctioning area from the DTC chart
When "Diagnosis ON Confirmation" confirms that the device supports old diagnosis, and there is a DTC in either "System Check Result Response" or "Diagnostic Memory Response"
Move to detailed inspection information display mode and inspect the malfunctioning area from the DTC chart
When there is no response to any of the commands "System Check Start Instruction", "System Check Result Request" or "Diagnostic Memory Request"
Inspect the power supply system and AVC-LAN communication wire harness of the device indicated by the device code (physical address)

step3.ptxt: To perform the service inspection again, press preset button "1".

atten3.ptxt: To inspect again after inspecting the wire harness, turn the IG OFF once and start over from the beginning.

step1.ptxt: Individual DTC Memory Clear (To Clear Past DTC Memory Individually)

step2.ptxt: While "ECHn" (Replace) is displayed in service inspection mode, or in detailed information display mode, press and hold preset button "5" for 2 seconds or more.

item.ptxt: When clearing of the DTC memory is complete, the buzzer sounds 1 times.
Since the diagnostic information of the target device is cleared, only the device code (physical address) is displayed.
To check the DTCs, press preset button "1" and perform the service inspection again.

step1.ptxt: All DTC Memory Clear (To Clear All Past DTC Memory)

step2.ptxt: After repairing the malfunctioning area, start diagnostic mode.

step3.ptxt: Press and hold preset button "5" for 2 seconds or more. (Display is CLr)

item.ptxt: When clearing of the DTC memory is complete, the buzzer sounds 1 times.
Since the diagnostic information of all devices is cleared, only the device codes (physical addresses) are displayed.

step2.ptxt: Press preset button "1", perform the service inspection again, and check that no malfunction is displayed for any device code (physical address).
